title: The reminder form's When field keeps the card's right margin on the iPhone
goal: On a phone the date-time field has the same inner padding and right margin as the What field
acceptance: A browser check at 320-430 px: every visible control of the reminder form (What, When) ends inside its card's content box
The When field shrinks to its column and matches the What field's height on iOS (iOS simulator, 390 px)
Style rule uses no new colour
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 from the owner phone check: one CSS rule and one browser check. Not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-27.
